title: coverage – register of what was searched (one search of one source)
description: A negative result is only meaningful with its ranges, name variants and method. Searching an index is not proof of absence (method/rules.md).

volume.description: volume searched, one of source.volumes when the source lists them (ADR 0058)

query.description: the search as typed into a database, full-text search or index (ADR 0035)

items.x-hint: each range needs dates, pages or – for a database search – query

names.description: Name variants searched for (all of them – a new variant later reopens the negative).

result.description: found / negative (searched, not there) / partial / inaccessible (access state, NOT a negative).

inquiry.description: method inquiry: the inquiry this search was made through (ADR 0036)

searched_by.description: Who did the search (ADR 0052): member – the member in `by` searched themselves; agent – an AI agent searched on the instruction of `by`.

agent_model.description: The model that searched, with searched_by: agent.

index_negative_accepted.description: A negative from an index only, accepted on purpose (ADR 0040): who decided, when and why the index is enough here.
